WITH sex_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN p.SEX IS NULL THEN 'missing'
      WHEN p.SEX = '' THEN 'blank'
      ELSE p.SEX 
    END as sex_group,
    COUNT(*) as exam_count
  FROM Examination e
  JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
  GROUP BY CASE 
    WHEN p.SEX IS NULL THEN 'missing'
    WHEN p.SEX = '' THEN 'blank'
    ELSE p.SEX 
  END
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(exam_count) as total_exams,
    COUNT(*) as num_sex_groups
  FROM sex_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.sex_group,
    sc.exam_count,
    sc.exam_count * 100.0 / t.total_exams as share_percent,
    100.0 / t.num_sex_groups as per_sex_avg,
    t.total_exams,
    t.num_sex_groups
  FROM sex_counts sc
  CROSS JOIN totals t
)
SELECT 
  sex_group,
  exam_count,
  share_percent,
  CAST(NULL AS REAL) as far_above_avg
FROM with_shares
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'ABOVE AVERAGE COMBINED' as sex_group,
  SUM(exam_count) as exam_count,
  SUM(exam_count) * 100.0 / MAX(total_exams) as share_percent,
  (SUM(exam_count) * 100.0 / MAX(total_exams) - COUNT(*) * MAX(per_sex_avg)) / COUNT(*) as far_above_avg
FROM with_shares
WHERE share_percent > per_sex_avg

assumptions.assumption: Per-sex average is the average share if evenly distributed: 100% divided by the number of distinct sex groups
Output includes all individual sex groups (above and below average) plus one additional combined row for groups above average, rather than only showing above-average groups
